cohort: The study included 204 mothers aged 18 years or older, residing in Abu Dhabi, UAE, who had a child three years old or younger.
finding: Breastfeeding for more than three months was significantly associated with reduced odds of moderate-to-severe Postpartum Depression among mothers in Abu Dhabi, UAE.
mod_finding: Delivery mode was included as a variable in the regression model but was not found to be significantly associated with Postpartum Depression.
cross-section timing: Data was collected from mothers whose youngest child was three years old or younger.
